terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A single realistic truck wheel: tall black rubber truck tyre with deep tread, painted dark grey steel disc rim with ring of lug nuts and a chrome hub cap. Photoreal studio product render, physically based materials, high detail. Seen exactly side-on, the wheel face looking straight at the camera, long telephoto lens, generous empty margin. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
